prompts.movement: Create a transparent pixel-art walking sprite sheet for the friendly digital companion ETCH shown in the reference. Match its lavender segmented armor, charcoal body, brass joint rings, bright amber eyes, elongated swept-back crest, small muzzle and short tail. Use the reference only for character appearance. This is a peaceful companion walking around its home village. Exactly 16 sprites in a uniform 4-column by 4-row grid, no text or borders. Row 1: four walking frames facing down/toward camera. Row 2: four walking frames facing left. Row 3: four walking frames facing right. Row 4: four walking frames facing up/away from camera. All frames same scale with a consistent foot baseline and generous transparent margins. Frame 1 standing contact pose, frame 2 left step, frame 3 passing pose, frame 4 right step. Clear alternating feet and arms, crisp limited-palette pixel clusters and dark outlines. Slight top-down RPG view. 1024x1024 canvas, cells 256x256, character about 140 pixels tall and centered at x128 with feet at y216 within each cell. No glow, no ground shadows, no props, no lettering.
prompts.daily: Create a second production pixel-art animation atlas of the SAME ETCH companion in the attached walking atlas. Reference image 1 locks character proportions, palette and linework; reference image 2 shows desired personality and action poses. Peaceful daily-life animations only. Transparent PNG, uniform 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 separate full-body frames; NO writing, labels, grid lines, poster panels or ground shadows. Same scale as image 1. Each cell 256x256 on a 1024 square canvas; consistently center the character, feet or resting body at y216. Crisp limited-palette pixel art, lavender segmented swept-back head crest, large amber eyes, brass wrists/ankles and chest, charcoal articulated torso, short tail. Row 1: four-frame front-facing IDLE breathing/blink loop, tiny chest/hand movement, feet stay planted. Row 2: four-frame SLEEP/REST loop: whole character curled on ground side-on facing left, eyes closed, subtle breathing, no text or Z symbols. Row 3: four-frame EATING loop front three-quarter view: hold a small golden morsel, lift it to mouth, nibble, lower hands; consistent creature proportions. Row 4: four-frame INTERACT/USE loop three-quarter facing right: lean forward, reach with articulated hand, touch small purple button, withdraw. Keep every row a coherent smooth cycle, enough transparent spacing to avoid neighboring cells.
prompts.expressions: Create a third matching pixel-art animation atlas for ETCH, the peaceful digital companion. Reference image 1 locks EXACT character design/proportions/colors and pixel style; image 2 gives expressive pose inspiration. Same lavender swept-back segmented crest, amber eyes, brass joints, charcoal small torso, claw hands and short tail. Transparent PNG, exact 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 frames, no lettering, labels, borders, poster elements or shadows. Same scale and per-cell ground baseline as image 1, ample transparent spacing, full body visible in every cell. Four coherent loops, each read left to right. Row 1 THINK/REHEARSE: three-quarter right, hand to chin, attentive eyes look up, eyes close thoughtfully, eyes reopen; no speech text. Row 2 REQUEST/QUESTION: front view, head tilt, one hand lifts palm upward, both hands briefly open in questioning gesture, returns to head tilt; no floating question mark. Row 3 PLEASED/SMALL SUCCESS: front three-quarter, eyes soften, small smile and small raised hands, modest cheerful bounce, settles to smile; no effects. Row 4 CURIOUS/INVESTIGATE: side three-quarter left, bends forward to inspect ground, crouches lower, tilts head close, straightens. Calm expressive companion poses, real changes to limbs and expression, no combat. Crisp readable pixel clusters consistent with supplied walking atlas, not painted illustration.
